profiles.organizer: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Buncombe County Center
profiles.mission: Extension Master Gardener volunteers work with NC State Extension to give gardeners unbiased, science-based information on garden and landscape practices.
profiles.work: You complete a 14-week, 40-hour training and exam, then a 40-hour internship, and afterwards record at least 30 volunteer hours and 15 continuing education hours each year.

profiles.work: You plant trees along floodplains and stream buffers at the yearly Creek ReLeaf event, or join short maintenance outings to trim growth, remove weeds, replace weed mats and straighten tree tubes.
